findings.text: follow-on: baseline_suite records completed true with three failure ids, but gate-base.log stops after twelve progress dots with no summary or EXIT line, so the recorded base arm is unreadable and the no-added-failure claim rests on the head arm's own zero failures rather than on a second readable arm.

follow-on: the positive control derives the start time it hands to _document from obligation_snapshot.process_start_time, the same helper freshness calls internally, so a consistently wrong process_start_time leaves this assertion green.
follow-on: the baseline_suite and after_suite command fields carry placeholders for the test-path lists in place of the literal command the manifest contract requires.
